description: This file defines classes related to text stream termination and processing, including terminator strategies and a templated stream text handler with support for different terminator sequences. It appears to be part of a core library for handling text streams with customizable termination behavior.

classes.name: TerminatorNull
classes.description: Handles null-terminated text streams, recognizing '�' as the terminator.

classes.name: TerminatorCarriageReturn
classes.description: Handles text streams terminated by a carriage return ('\n').

classes.name: TerminatorCarriageReturnLineFeed
classes.description: Handles text streams terminated by a sequence of carriage return and line feed ('\r\n').

classes.name: StreamTextType
classes.description: A templated class managing text stream processing with customizable terminator behavior, including handling of received text, sending data, and state changes.

methods.name: IsTerminated
methods.description: Determines if a character indicates termination based on the terminator type.

methods.name: SizeOf
methods.description: Returns the size of the terminator sequence.

methods.name: Marker
methods.description: Returns the terminator sequence as a string.

methods.name: ReceiveData
methods.description: Processes received data, extracting characters and detecting termination sequences.
